purpose: Read-only competitor UI comparison for Torch and Fill

safety.visibleInitialCanvas: Standard Farm base map with built-in greenhouse and farmhouse; no added user item visible in initial screenshot
safety.reasonCanvasWasNotEdited: Competitor localStorage contained three saved-map key-family entries; their values were not read.

observations.action: Selected Torch, then hovered unselected Jungle Torch result
observations.note: The selected Torch row has class .sel but its row background is transparent when not hovered; with selected Torch hovered its background is rgb(8, 140, 89). The unselected hovered Jungle Torch row uses rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055). The screenshot was captured while the Torch result was visibly green.

observations.action: Read visible status text after selecting Fill with Torch and Tilled Dirt
observations.result: Both showed a Filling <item> status and Drag to fill · Esc to cancel; no unsupported/not supported message was visible.
